issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Stock.add(String) as returning void, but both the template and solution implementations define Stock.add(String) to return an int. This mismatch between the specification (problem_statement.md) and the provided code can confuse students about the expected method signature and return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the problem statement UML with the code by updating the UML to declare +add(String): int, or alternatively change the template and solution Stock.add method to return void. Prefer updating the UML to +add(String): int to match the existing template and solution implementations.
